claim_boundary: Retrospective single-cohort patient-level internal validation only. The study estimates how diagnostic performance changes when a fixed, blinded budget of one to four routine photographs from the same eligible patient_group is available. ConvNeXt-Tiny is the fixed primary architecture; EfficientNetV2-M and Swin-T are supporting stability analyses. The study does not establish external generalization, a clinical acquisition guideline, a deployment threshold, clinician performance, or the anatomical meaning of any photograph.

data.runtime_path_rule: The frozen manifest remains unchanged. At a mounted runtime, canonical_relative_path may resolve pixels under an explicitly declared image root; this is I/O only and never a model, split, selection, or statistical field.

definitions.at_least_four_photographs: all eligible patient_group values with at least four active manifest photographs; the same primary patient groups are used for every K=1,2,3,4 comparison

views.selection_rule: For every eligible patient_group, SHA256(patient_group, order_seed) initializes a complete randomized order of the group's image_id-sorted active photographs. Budget K is the first K photographs of that fixed order. No label, model score, filename, quality value, or other manifest field may affect ordering or selection.
views.training_rule: Each epoch uses exactly one scheduled budget K for every patient_group. Training samples K photographs without replacement from that group's frozen primary four-photograph order using SHA256(seed, epoch, patient_group); the shared model is never given K or any photograph-count feature.

preprocessing.resize_rule: preserve aspect ratio and pad to a 224x224 square

aggregation.rule: Exactly one shared image model is trained per split, seed, and backbone with patient-level mean-logit binary cross entropy. Each route writes ordered z1..z4 values to image_logits.csv, rebuilds every K=1..4 mean, top-2 mean, and max probability from that artifact before completion, and writes patient-level predictions only after that reconstruction passes. Top-2 mean and max are prespecified inference contrasts, not separately optimized models.

architecture_robustness.rule: This is a predeclared supporting architecture-replication analysis. The fixed ConvNeXt-Tiny primary route supplies the main result, while EfficientNetV2-M and Swin-T are trained in supporting routes. All three use the same locked K-agnostic mean-training schedule and are evaluated at K=1,2,3,4. It does not select a backbone, threshold, budget, or primary claim, and it does not add learned fusion modules or non-patient-level inputs.

cpu_logit_postprocessing.feature_rule: For each K, use only the first K ordered image logits from the locked photograph prefix, sort those logits in descending order, and fit one low-capacity patient-level aggregator for that K. No image count, metadata, filename, source, batch, or label-derived feature is allowed.
cpu_logit_postprocessing.nested_rule: Within each outer fold and formal seed, select the declared aggregator configuration by three-fold cross-fitted log loss on the outer-training patient groups, refit it on all cross-fitted inner logits, and apply it once to the outer-test logits. Select one outer-fold threshold from the formal-seed-averaged cross-fitted inner probabilities at minimum specificity 0.90.
cpu_logit_postprocessing.role: Secondary exploratory comparison against the shared-logit mean, top-2 mean, and maximum inference rules. It does not retrain the image encoder, alter the primary mean-aggregation analysis, select a backbone, or define a new confirmatory endpoint.

comparisons.multiplicity: The sole primary hypothesis test is mean-aggregation K4-versus-K1 standardized partial AUROC at FPR <= 0.10. Pooled OOF sensitivity at 90% specificity, AUPRC, overall AUROC, Brier, ECE, FNR, top-2 mean, and max are secondary or exploratory results with patient-level confidence intervals.

counterfactual_evaluation.rule: For each K>=2, reversed_prefix is an implementation-invariance check for symmetric aggregation. duplicate_view1 repeats the first K=1 photograph K times and must equal the K=1 probability for mean, top-2 mean, and max aggregation. lowpass_view1 applies a fixed reporting-only low-pass perturbation to the first photograph while retaining the remaining photographs, testing whether additional inputs buffer one impaired photograph. Reversal and duplicate conditions are implementation gates; lowpass_view1 is a supporting robustness analysis, not a diagnostic-superiority claim.

pilot.rule: Development-only inner-validation runtime and artifact check. It never evaluates the held-out outer fold and cannot select a budget, backbone, threshold, or final claim.

model.image_head: one scalar logit from a shared image encoder
model.top2_mean_aggregation: z_K = mean of the two largest image logits when K >= 2; for K=1, z_K = z_1

early_stopping.outer_epoch_rule: 4 * median(best_cycle) across inner validation routes, clamped to [12,60]

training.memory_strategy: one K-view diagnostic forward/backward/optimizer step per patient batch
training.patient_sampler: Every available training patient_group appears exactly once per epoch; no with-replacement oversampling is used.
